title: Solution Brief
description: Primary machine-readable handoff from the Solution Architect. Produced before requirements or architecture are locked. Consumed by Technical Architect (for adr-spec.json), Business Analyst (for feature-ticket.json), Product Manager (go/no-go), and Agent Coordinator (solution scoping gate). Captures problem framing, capability gaps, build-vs-buy decision, AI feasibility, agent ROI, and compliance constraints.

brief_id.description: Unique identifier. Convention: sb-NNN-short-slug or YYYY-MM-DD-slug.

initiative.description: Name of the initiative or business problem being scoped.

problem_statement.description: Business framing that all downstream roles must respect.

constraints.description: Budget, timeline, team, platform, or regulatory constraints.

capability_map.description: Current vs required capability mapping consumed by Technical Architect for boundary scoping.

partial.description: Capabilities available with constraints (performance ceilings, licensing, ownership gaps).

options_considered.description: At least 2 options with explicit trade-offs. The recommendation must reference one of these.

data_boundary.description: What data leaves our system and where.

mcp_marketplace_evaluation.description: Required when an MCP marketplace tool is a candidate.

ai_solution_assessment.description: Present when an AI/agentic approach is on the table.

single_llm_vs_multi_agent.description: Decision and rationale; default to the simpler single-LLM architecture unless multi-agent is explicitly justified.

agent_roi_estimate.description: Required when recommending an agentic solution at CFO/board level. All four P&L-connected pillars.

regulations_in_scope.description: e.g. GDPR, PDPA, EU AI Act, sector-specific.

named_constraints.description: One per regulation: what the solution must do / must not do / must demonstrate.

stakeholder_summary.description: Non-technical, decision-ready summary for business stakeholders.

problem_statement.business_problem: Support triage takes 6+ hours median; SLA breaches rising 12% MoM.
stakeholder_goals: Cut median triage time under 1 hour
Preserve human ownership of refund/credit decisions
constraints: EU customer data must stay in-region

build_vs_buy_decision.rationale: In-region data constraint and auditability favor an in-house hybrid classifier over SaaS triage tools that transit data out of region.
build_vs_buy_decision.data_boundary: Ticket text stays in EU region; only category label returned

ai_solution_assessment.business_value_justification: LLM outperforms keyword rules on ambiguous, multi-intent tickets.
ai_solution_assessment.confidence_threshold_required: 0.80 for auto-routing; below routes to human queue
ai_solution_assessment.hitl_requirement: Refund/credit and account-closure categories always route to a human agent
ai_solution_assessment.explainability_requirement: Show top category + confidence + matched signals to the agent
ai_solution_assessment.fallback_behavior: Below-threshold or model-unavailable tickets fall back to the deterministic keyword router
ai_solution_assessment.single_llm_vs_multi_agent: Single LLM with tool access; multi-agent not justified for a single-step classification task

named_constraints: GDPR: ticket text must not leave the EU region
EU AI Act (limited-risk): disclose AI-assisted triage to agents
requires_operational_process: Agent-facing AI disclosure in the console

recommendation.rationale: Meets accuracy goal within constraints; deterministic fallback preserves safety and reversibility.
key_risks: Model drift degrading classification accuracy over time
conditions_that_change_recommendation: If in-region inference cost exceeds budget, revert to rule-based refresh

examples.stakeholder_summary: We recommend an in-house AI triage assistant that keeps EU data in region, routes only high-confidence tickets automatically, and always sends refund and account decisions to a human. Deterministic rules remain as a safe fallback.

open_questions.question: Which EU region endpoint has approved capacity?

handoff.to_technical_architect: Capability gaps: real-time classification, confidence-gated routing. Enforce region-pinned inference boundary in the ADR.
handoff.to_business_analyst: HITL categories (refund, credit, account closure) and the 0.80 confidence threshold must appear in acceptance criteria.
handoff.to_product_manager: Trade-off: inference cost vs accuracy - go/no-go on the hybrid option.
